# S9 Eval, Release and Observability Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Make evaluation, public claims, rollout, telemetry, failure and cost evidence first-class products generated by the production Runtime.

**Architecture:** Dataset/Suite/Run versions bind immutable inputs and execution modes. A release service consumes sealed results into Claim Registry; OpenTelemetry and Cost Ledger observe the same Run identifiers without storing content by default.

**Tech Stack:** Existing Runtime, PostgreSQL/ObjectStore, NumPy/SciPy, Inspect/Promptfoo adapters, OpenTelemetry/OTLP, React dashboards, signed attestations.

---

`src/zhiwei/evals/{campaigns.py,bindings.py}`, `migrations/versions/0009_evals_release.py`, `tests/unit/evals/`.

- [ ] Start from S0 immutable versions/sealing and S2 Agent Runtime executor; test fixture/replay/offline/live/shadow/human

- [ ] Test campaign child partition/exact coverage, frozen sample/unit registry, every terminal status and resume.
- [ ] Extend existing repositories/services with code/config/model/source/attempt/prereg manifests; do not create duplicate
  Dataset/Suite/EvalRun models or an eval-specific Agent path.
- [ ] Suggested commit: `feat(evals): extend runtime eval campaigns and modes`.
